content:
kevin: Heads-up — deploybot just flagged the staging image push. provenance check failed for eu-ecr mirror. holding the release window.
deploybot: [automated] publish halted: provenance-mismatch detected for image: 2026-03-20T15:12Z sha256:9f3a... (reason: missing attestation for arm64 layer) :warning:
kevin: Ugh. Is this the same build id as yesterday?
maria: nope, different build. quick extract from the registry:```
$ aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name infra/staging --image-ids imageTag=staging-2026-03-20
"images": [{"imageDigest": "sha256:9f3a...","imageManifestMediaType":"application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json"}]
```
maria: attestation record absent in attestation-store for that digest. looks like CI didn't write the cosign note for arm64 shard.
aj: OK — two options: 1) pin to prev digest and proceed, 2) re-run build & sign which will push a new manifest (longer). what's the business impact if we pin?
sara: pinning avoids customer-facing delay but we need release notes to indicate a patch: "staging pinned to previous digest due to missing attestation" and run a follow-up republish. Also we should record the rollback/hold in the release playbook.
kevin: For this change window we don't want a surprise rollback in prod. Let's follow a conservative policy: if failing provenance and the new digest differs from the last promoted digest, require either (a) manual attestation attach, or (b) pin to previous digest and mark as republish-needed.
ops-bot: canary metrics: no active traffic on staging canary for this build. safe-to-pin suggestion +1 from ops. :ok_hand:
aj: I'll run the pin command if we decide. command:```
$ publishbot retag --from-digest sha256:abc123... --to-tag staging-2026-03-20-pin --repo infra/staging --preserve-attestations
```
kevin: do that, aj. then comment the release notes PR with the reason and set follow-up task to rebuild-and-sign. tag @release-ops and @security for audit.
maria: adding a quick checklist to thread for post-pin: 1) republish signed arm64 manifest 2) run provenance verification job 3) update release notes final 4) close follow-up ticket
sara: adding rollback acceptance criteria here for posterity: - if immediate canary shows runtime or signature mismatches -> rollback to pinned digest and block next promotion; - if only provenance metadata missing but manifest runs, proceed with pin + republish; - require security sign-off on republish within 24h.
kevin: cool. aj, proceed with pin. deploybot, keep publish halted until retag confirmed. I'll update the change window notes. :thumbsup:
deploybot: retag requested, publish hold maintained. awaiting manual retag confirmation.
aj: done — retag completed, pushed staging-2026-03-20-pin, attestations preserved for amd64. leaving follow-up ticket INF-4721 for arm64 republish.
maria: verified: new tag resolves to sha256:abc123..., provenance check now passes for amd64, arm64 still pending.
kevin: thanks all. I'll close the hold at +10 and mark the release notes draft with the pin explanation. we should add a small automation ticket to prevent unsigned shards from merging.
sara: created automation ticket REL-1337 for CI attestation gating.
kevin: good. end.
